站在这个重要的时间节点回望，我深感责任之重，亦对团队展现出的生命力感到欣慰。

关于你的问题，首先，在初始优先事项中，**“数字化底座（Digital Foundation）”**的演进最为显著。起初，我们将数字化视为降本增效的技术工具，但现在它已进化为驱动财富管理和非利息收入结构性增长的核心引擎。它不再仅仅是后台支撑，而是我们穿越宏观周期、捕捉亚洲增长机遇的最前沿利器。

其次，我认为星展银行目前最大的“胜果”在于我们成功验证了**“战略韧性（Strategic Resilience）”**。在利率环境波动与全球经济转型交织的复杂局势下，我们不仅维持了盈利能力的韧性，更在财富管理和数字化转型领域实现了高质量的突破。这种确定性不仅体现在财报数据上，更体现在市场对星展银行领导力平稳交接及未来盈利路径的坚定信心。

综上所述，我们将继续秉持“稳健领航”的姿态，为股东和客户创造长远的“可持续增长”价值。📈🇸🇬

Thank you for the insightful question. Reflecting on this journey since taking the helm on 28 March 2025, I am reminded of the immense responsibility and the exciting opportunities that lie ahead for DBS.

Firstly, regarding priorities, the one that has evolved the most is our perspective on "Digital Resilience." While my initial focus was heavily centered on fortifying our technical infrastructure to ensure absolute stability following the challenges of 2025, this priority has evolved into building a proactive "Digital Foundation." We are now moving beyond mere reliability to leverage GenAI and our "Alpha" squads to drive "Strategic Synergy" and operational leverage. We have shifted from a defensive posture to using technology as a primary engine for "Sustainable Growth."

Secondly, I believe the biggest win for DBS under my leadership so far has been the demonstrated "Strategic Resilience" of our earnings power. Despite the headwinds in Net Interest Margin (NIM) and global macro volatility, we have maintained our ROE guidance of 15-17%. This isn't just a number; it is a validation of our strategic transition and the market's confidence in our ability to deliver "Alpha" even in a higher-for-longer interest rate environment. The successful integration of our digital-led wealth management strategy across the ASEAN-Greater China corridor is a clear manifestation of this success.

In conclusion, the past year has reinforced my belief that a steady hand and a clear, forward-looking vision are essential for navigating the complexities of modern banking. Our commitment remains to deliver long-term value for our shareholders and stakeholders, ensuring that DBS continues to lead with confidence. 📈🇸🇬
